modes.roundtrip: Create the frozen box at its final pose before normal bootstrap. Start at recorded named Home; no setup arm command. Independently check fresh actual Home and retained target/witness geometry before first RRT. Execute global move_to_pose to historical START then runtime Home with the box unchanged. Both directions require >.02rad measured arm displacement.
modes.direct_reference: Create no physical external box. Start at the same measured Home and issue existing direct move_to_pose to the same target. Independently intersect its captured cooked solid poses with the frozen counterfactual box offline; no actual impact required.

Strict zero reports and physical contact-free completion remain separate; no harmless-contact threshold

Both operation RRT/route/trajectory planning diagnostics, simulation/wall execution duration and final pose errors
All-scene and fixture-only per-link clearance and closest pair, per-step fixture clearance curve
